newsitem.title: DENMARK: Dealers see Danish share index on the way to 200.
newsitem.headline: Dealers see Danish share index on the way to 200.

text.p: The strong dollar and rising markets throughout Europe on Wednesday took Denmark's top 20 share index to a record high for the 12th consecutive trading day and dealers said that next month's first-half company results could take it to the dizzying 200-point level.
"If we get some good indicators the index could well hit 200 when the first-half results are published," a trader said.

The KFX top-20 index closed up 2.42 point, at 190.38, in overall bourse turnover of 1.59 billion crowns. Its August future, for settlement today, rose 2.80 point to 191.50, with 2,447 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Shipping and oil group A.P. Moeller's two constituent shares continued to rise, boosted both by the firm dollar and the performance of the group's Maersk Oil and Gas, which is producing more than expected in Qatar and has now tendered for concessions in Bangla Desh.
Moeller's DS Svendborg rose 2.2 precent to 410,000 crowns per share and DS 1912 climbed 2.1 percent to 285,000.
SAS had heavy turnover of 1.2 million shares traded but the price only rose two crowns, to 90.00. REUTER
